scope: All VBA source modules under src, including WIP; tests and templates excluded.
method: Source annotations, reachable Git history and merged PR provenance. Codex/T3 branch names and explicit AI co-authors establish involvement, not scrutiny. No style-based detection. Targeted read-only inspection of local Cursor history established a GPT-5 stdShell refactor dated 2025-09-20; private transcripts are not published. Reviewed the supplied index of 43 local Codex session logs; stdJSON and stdEnumerator implementation/commit records replace their previous date-only estimates. Excluded disclosure work itself as evidence and did not attribute unmerged experiments to current master. Cursor follow-up searched all 53 workspace records and all 40 available transcript files; completed edits plus retained code establish stdHTML AI:W.
policy: Use evidence of human scrutiny for AI:W and explicit evidence of AI:X for AI:X. Unknown scrutiny is not AI:X. Dates and model names guide investigation but do not establish scrutiny. Record the earliest evidenced retained AI contribution with @aidate and its limited scope with @aidesc; an absent @ai means classification unresolved, not handmade. Dates use a matched edit timestamp or commit date, documented per module.

localHistoryNameSearch.matching: Case-insensitive whole-name search of every JSONL line for every source filename stem and Attribute VB_Name; includes standard modules and WIP.
localHistoryNameSearch.interpretation: Mentions include copied source, tool output, directory listings, dependencies and changelog text. They are discovery evidence, not proof of AI writing. Duplicate class names across source paths share name hits and require path disambiguation.
localHistoryNameSearch.followUp: Inspected mutation-shaped tool calls and associated discussion for currently unmarked classes. Hits concerned dependency/test setup, documentation, historical changelog work or unmerged experiments; no additional merged implementation-writing evidence was established. The later stdCallback changes documented calling conventions and added tests; its implementation mark remains AI:W.
localHistoryNameSearch.privacy: Only coverage counts and conclusions are published; local paths, conversation identifiers and transcript text are omitted.
localHistoryNameSearch.source: The 43 indexed Codex session logs; Cursor coverage is recorded separately.

cursorHistorySearch.method: Read-only global database queries selected the exact workspace headers, composerData bodies and bubbleId messages. Every available matching transcript JSONL line was also searched for source filename stems and VB_Name aliases. Source-write tool arguments were inspected by exact destination path and completion status; current code/Git history were checked for retained changes.
cursorHistorySearch.limits: One untitled September 2025 record has no stored bubble messages. The current project-usage-analysis conversation was searched but excluded as implementation-authorship evidence. Missing messages cannot establish absence of AI use. Name collisions between classes require path disambiguation. Private transcripts and local identifiers are not published.
cursorHistorySearch.finding: Retained Cursor changes establish AI involvement in HTML, WebView, Shell and an earlier JSON fix. Maintainer-described Cursor-era scrutiny supports W for the first three; JSON has later AI changes whose scrutiny remains unverified. Unmerged Lambda experiments do not establish current APIs.

classificationReview: Blame and dated commit diffs were cross-checked against supplied conversations for all 21 previously annotated classes. Retain AI:X only for the explicitly confirmed Regex thunk. Enumerator and Window conversations show human scrutiny; other disputed W/X assignments remain unresolved. Small patches do not establish an AI-made class, and patch size alone does not establish human review.
